description: Render a map to a PNG image so you can SEE what it looks like: all tile layers with correct autotile shapes, shadows and tiles that draw above characters, optionally the events' character sprites, coloured event markers with their ids, region ids, a tile grid and a passability overlay (red = blocked in at least one direction). This is the visual counterpart of render_map (text) - use it after paint_tiles / create_event / connect_maps to check your work. Marker colours: blue = event with a Transfer Player command (door/exit), orange = shows text, magenta = autorun/parallel, green = anything else. Needs the tileset images in img/tilesets (sheets without an image are drawn as flat colours and listed). Large maps are shrunk to fit ~1600px; pass x/y/width/height to zoom into a region and raise tileSize for detail.

height.description: Region height in tiles (default: to the map's bottom edge)

showEvents.description: Draw event character sprites, coloured id markers, both, or neither

showPassability.description: Tint blocked cells translucent red (blocked in at least one direction by the tileset flags)

tileSize.description: Pixels per map tile (48 = full resolution). Reduced automatically so the image stays under ~1600px

width.description: Region width in tiles (default: to the map's right edge)

name: render_map_image
title: Render map as image
